propositions: Contributors and agents must fast-forward their own worktree (not the shared main checkout) after a Gerrit merge, before closing a ticket, to ensure the merged rebar-ticket commit is reachable from HEAD during the completion precheck.

The transition close completion verifier (_referencing_commit_exists) reads git log from the repo_root with ref=HEAD to confirm the merged work is reachable, and fails with 'cannot confirm the work landed' if the worktree is stale.
Documentation (AGENTS.md and CONTRIBUTING.md) lacked explicit post-merge fast-forward guidance, leading operators to incorrectly fast-forward the shared main checkout and clobber uncommitted WIP.
AGENTS.md must add a bullet under the 'Git workflow' section stating 'git fetch origin && git merge --ff-only origin/main' on the worktree and warning never to touch the shared main checkout.
CONTRIBUTING.md must add a new §2f subsection ('After merge — fast-forward your worktree, THEN close the ticket') immediately after §2e with identical guidance.
